P. 7</ls>. .²6 A functionary, one who is in charge of anything; त्वं तस्य भव वश्यश्च विधेयश्च सदानघ <ls>Rām. 2. 30. 9</ls>. .{@-यम्@} .²1 What ought to be done, a duty; विधीयतां तत्र विधेयमुत्तरम् <ls>Ki. 1. 25</ls>, <ls n="Ki.">16. 62</ls>. .²2 The predicate of a proposition. .{@-यः@} A servant, dependant.
